claims: - **Laboratory check.** Millimetre-scale penitentes form between 50 and 2000 Pa at -15 to -2 °C, only close to the equilibrium vapour pressure. Away from it the ice sublimates into a smooth crater. Spacing agrees with the Claudin model (Berisford et al. 2024).
